analysis: The learned depth mixture completed successfully but reduced macro validation HR@10 to 0.5388 versus the reported parent’s 0.57 (−0.0312). Electronics declined from 0.35 to 0.34; category HR@10 was Movies 0.56, Industrial 0.615, Electronics 0.34, and CDs 0.64. This trial does not support replacing uniform depth averaging with freely learned weights under the retained training settings. Learned weights and optimization traces were not supplied, so the cause of the regression is unconfirmed. Deterministic fixtures and predictor consistency checks completed without failure.
code_summary: Each category independently trains a 64-dimensional LightGCN with two sparse propagation steps. Three zero-initialized logits learn a softmax mixture of the initial, one-hop, and two-hop embeddings. Scoring retains item biases and a 0.5-weighted history profile with a ten-interaction half-life. Training retains differentiable positive-target exclusion, recency-weighted positives, 32 uniform unseen negatives with replacement, sampled-softmax loss, and Adam at 0.003. Export materializes the learned mixture into the existing predictor buffers, preserving all four dataset routes and inference behavior.
